# GECMM (Guangzhou Excellent Creation Medical Material)

> > China-based manufacturer and supplier of disposable PPE products including nitrile gloves, protective coveralls, isolation gowns, and non-woven protective equipment meeting FDA, EN455, EN374, and ASTM D6319 standards.

GECMM specializes in manufacturing medical-grade and industrial disposable protective equipment using SMS, SMMS, PE, and polypropylene materials. The company offers ISO 9001/13485 certified products with customization services for bulk orders.

## Key Topics

- Nitrile Gloves
- Disposable Coveralls
- SMS Material
- SMMS Material
- Isolation Gowns
- FDA Approval
- EN455 Standard
- EN374 Standard
- ASTM D6319
- Powder-Free Gloves
- Latex-Free Products
- Protective Clothing
- Medical PPE
- ISO 13485 Certification
- Polypropylene Non-Woven Fabric
